hooks.name: Restrict fetch MCP to allowed sources
hooks.description: Blocks fetch MCP calls to any host other than clinicaltrials.gov and data.cdc.gov (cdc.gov), per health-safety steering. Exits 2 to block disallowed domains. Matcher targets the MCP fetch tool (e.g. fetch::fetch, mcp_fetch_fetch) and deliberately excludes the built-in web_fetch tool.
